invitation.leadIn: A few things were gathered here on purpose.
invitation.title: A little something for Sharu.

introduction.headline: Made of small things.
body: A few memories, a few words, and one soundtrack that felt right.
Nothing too complicated. Just something assembled with you in mind.

playful.subtitle: Four tiny questions. No right answers — just little windows into how you see the world.

options.label: Treating iced coffee as an essential food group
Keeping far too many browser tabs open
options.response: There is absolutely a system. Nobody else is allowed to understand it.

options.label: Being suspiciously happy when plans get cancelled
options.response: An unexpectedly free evening is a small luxury.

questions.subtitle: When plans suddenly disappear, what is your first reaction?

options.label: Finally. An evening with absolutely no obligations.
Wait… but I had already mentally prepared for it.
options.response: A carefully constructed plan deserves its moment.

options.label: Depends. I may immediately invent a better plan.

questions.prompt: A tiny window into your brain.
questions.subtitle: What kind of compliment actually stays with you?

options.label: You make people feel comfortable being themselves.
options.response: That says a lot about what you value.

options.label: You are ridiculously good at what you do.
options.response: Quiet competence is hard to fake.

options.label: You make ordinary things more fun.
options.response: You notice atmosphere, not just outcomes.

questions.prompt: Pick the kind of memory you would keep.
questions.subtitle: If you could preserve one ordinary moment forever…

options.label: A late-night conversation that went nowhere and everywhere.
A completely stupid moment that still makes you laugh.
A quiet place where you felt completely at peace.

questions.subtitle: Which future sounds most like you?

options.label: A life full of stories I can’t believe actually happened.
A life that feels calm, meaningful and very much mine.
A life where the people I love are doing well too.

moments.subtitle: The message, photos and soundtrack you chose live here.

items.heading: Something I wanted to say
items.body: There are things that are probably easier to feel than to explain, but this much is simple: I'm really glad you're in my life.

realization.headline: None of this was random.

threads.clue: The words, the pictures, the song...
threads.subtext: Each one was chosen because it reminded me of you.

threads.clue: The tiny habits are the real clues.
threads.subtext: The things you barely notice are often the things other people remember.

threads.clue: The way you make ordinary moments feel.
threads.subtext: That feeling is harder to photograph, but impossible to miss.
This is where the little observations become one very specific person.

realization.realizationMessage: This little world was put together for Sharu, one choice at a time.

appreciation.headline: Happy Birthday, Sharu.
paragraphs: There are things that are probably easier to feel than to explain, but this much is simple: I'm really glad you're in my life.
I hope the year ahead gives you plenty of reasons to be happy, curious, and completely yourself.
appreciation.warmSignoff: Made with a lot of thought

ending.birthdayWish: Wishing you a really wonderful year ahead.
ending.pressureFreeNote: No need to reply. Just enjoy the moment.
